description: Reorder, caption or REMOVE the photos a product already has. Send the photos as they should be afterwards: the order given is the display order (the first is the main photo), each alt replaces the stored caption (empty clears it), and a current photo you leave out is removed from the product (the stored file is kept, exactly as when a person removes a photo in the product form). Returns the new list and how many were removed. It never adds photos: every url must already belong to the product, otherwise the call is refused and nothing changes — use add_product_images to add. Idempotent: the same call twice leaves the same result. Saves through the product form's own operation. Call get_product first and copy the urls exactly. The result echoes the workspace.

images.description: The product's photos as they should be AFTER the change: the order given becomes the display order (the first is the main photo) and each alt replaces the stored caption (empty clears it). A current photo you leave out is REMOVED from the product; the stored file is kept, as when a person removes it in the product form. Every url must already belong to the product — to add a photo use add_product_images.

alt.description: Caption (alt text) of the photo, up to 200 characters. Empty or omitted: the storefront falls back to the product name. Do not invent a description of what you cannot see.

url.description: The url of a photo the product ALREADY has, exactly as get_product returns it.

productId.description: The product id from search_products or get_product.

name: update_product_images
title: Reorder, caption or remove product images
